To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a highly sensitive and miniaturized lab-on-a-chib platform based on nanophotonic sensors for single nucleotide detection.
we have developed ulrasensitive nanophotonic biosensors based on Si waveguides able to be integrated into lab-on-a-chips.
we have developed ulrasensitive and miniaturised photonic silicon sensors integrated in a lab-on-a-chips microsystem for detection of single DNA nucleotides.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new technology for ultrasensitive DNA testing based on photonic sensors integrated in a lab-on-a-chib microsystem platform.
the development of a miniaturized and ultrasensitive biosensor based on photonic silicon sensors, integrated in a lab-on-a-chips microsystem platform for single nucleotide polymorphism DNA testing.
the development and characterization of ultrasensitive nanophotonic silicon biosensors for single molecule detection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the developed photonic biosensors are very promising for DNA detection and for the detection of SNPs at the BRCA-2 gene.
we have developed a new generation of ultrasensitive and compact photonic biosensors for single DNA testing.
we have developed a novel lab-on-a-chib platform based on highly sensitive and miniaturized nanophotonic silicon biosensors for single-nucleotide DNA testing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that the nanophotonic biosensor is a very sensitive tool to be integrated in the microfluidic lab-on-a-chips.
the lab-on-chip microsystems based on nanophotonic biosensors can be a powerful tool for ultrasensitive and low cost DNA analysis in point-of-care applications.
we have demonstrated a new generation of ultrasensitive and compact optical biosensors for single DNA testing, with a great potential for point of care testing and personalized medicine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the integration of the biosensor with a microfluidic channel allows to perform a single nucleotide detection with a simple and easy operation.
we have developed an ultrasensitive and highly integrated photonic biosensor for DNA detection.
the combination of nanoscale optical sensors and micro/nanofabrication technology is a powerful tool to develop highly sensitive, miniaturized and portable biosensors for single molecule analysis.
